headline: Margins widen and profit climbs, but net income slips
summary_short: Workday reported FY2026 Q2 revenue of $2,542M, up 8.3% y/y, with operating income up 36.3% y/y to $338M even as net income slipped 2.6% y/y to $222M.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.3% y/y to $2,542M, about flat q/q. Gross profit increased 13.8% y/y to $1,938M. Operating income grew 36.3% y/y to $338M, near a 13.3% margin, roughly flat q/q. EBIT rose 188.6% y/y to $381M and EBITDA rose 119.0% y/y to $473M. Diluted EPS was $0.87, up 3.6% y/y, flat q/q. Net income of $222M fell 2.6% y/y, flat q/q.
